item.title: Community water quality forum launched in Galway Bay South East Catchment
item.description: Galwegians embraced the chance to play their part in the protection and restoration of water quality in the Galway Bay South East catchment area, turning up in numbers for the inaugural meeting of a new community-led group in Loughrea recently. item.title: UHG ED wins bronze accreditation for commitment to the environment
item.description: The Emergency Department at University Hospital Galway has been awarded Bronze Accreditation in the Royal College of Emergency Medicine GreenED initiative – recognising the team’s commitment to environmental responsibility and innovative waste-reduction practices in one of the hospital’s busiest clinical areas. item.title: Galway student among winners of all island ‘Poetry Aloud’ competition
item.description: A second level student from Galway was among the big winners at the all-island Poetry Aloud competition – which involves reciting a prescribed poem from memory – the final of which was held at the National Library of Ireland this week.
